summary: Consumer Portfolio Services, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a securitization of subprime automotive receivables. Its subsidiary CPS Receivables Five LLC purchased $526.17M of receivables and sold them to CPS Auto Receivables Trust 2026-B, which issued $514.07M of asset-backed notes in five classes. Credit enhancement includes over-collateralization and a 1% reserve account. CPS will act as servicer. The transaction is treated as a secured financing for accounting and tax purposes. This is an ordinary-course securitization, not a special situation.
